title: Grateful Dead Live at Irvine Meadows on 1986-04-13
source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Darby; SennheiserMD421's (PAS/Loge Row 6 Row FF Seat 617/6 Feet High)> Sony TC D5M,Tapes Maxell MX; Transfer Information:Tascam 112 MKII (XLR Out)>Tascam HD-P2 @ 24/48> HDD>Amadeus Pro (Tracking/Fades/FLAC8); Tracks Renamed/Metadata Tagging With Tag&Rename By Keo

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality recording of a solid show with standout China > Rider and Looks Like Rain, though the Terrapin is truncated.
ai_review.review: The performance is generally strong – Jerry cruises through the set, China > Rider gets interesting sprinkles and Looks Like Rain shines above average. The only notable oddity is a shortened Terrapin that ends abruptly. The copy sounds real good, suggesting a clear source despite no explicit source type.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review; it praises the musical set (especially China > Rider and Looks Like Rain) and notes good sound quality, leading to a moderate‑high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer mentions the sound is "real good" with no noted issues, implying clear and listenable audio.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall solid flow; the only blemish is a truncated Terrapin that ends unexpectedly, but it does not detract heavily from the set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Cruising right along the whole show, tone described as good.
